entry.title: Silicyte Ratchet (silicyte-0119) registered: does a verified-helper library compound on ARC-AGI-1?
entry.summary: Registered as silicyte-0119 at 16:46 ET on 2026-11-04 and committed as cc5fb5b at 16:47 ET, before any model call. A growing library of verified Python helpers (STOCK) must beat STATIC, ONE-SHOT, EXEMPLAR, SHAM and FLAT-TTC at equal total tokens on 400 sealed ARC-AGI-1 evaluation tasks, with PLANT-DRIP and PLANT-L1 as positive controls. Registered prediction: STOCK minus STATIC +2 of 400, 80% band [-8, +14], calibrated band [-10.68, +17.216], P(COMPOUNDS) 0.15. Result pending; it will be published whatever it shows.

entry.title: Restart: Silicyte now tests whether AI self-improvement compounds
entry.summary: Silicyte now leads with one question: does AI self-improvement compound, measured by pre-registered, compute-matched tests on sealed data. Our earlier guardrail headline, a hook absent on 29.8% of 103,850 calls on one laptop, measured 0.0000 at a 15 s budget on clean public runners in every cell up to 24 agents. It belongs to that laptop, so it moves to earlier work, with every load-test result left public.
